article.headline: Multi-Day Indian Wedding Logistics: Mehndi, Sangeet, Baraat, Ceremony, Reception
article.description: A complete operational plan for a 4-day Indian wedding — mehndi, sangeet, baraat, ceremony, and reception — with timing, vendor sequencing, and the logistics rules that prevent collapse.
